title: Independent thermochemical test of PyDIG photoisomer basicity
difficulty_reasons: The fixed endpoint requires paired neutral/protonated thermochemistry and conformer coverage, while the agent must independently choose and validate a route.
Protonated PyDIG has multiple close-lying conformational possibilities, making state selection and sensitivity analysis substantive.

paper.title: Photo-DAC: Light-Driven Ambient-Temperature Direct Air Capture by a Photobase
paper.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

data.description: Self-contained PyDIG structures and aqueous experimental context.

required_deliverables.description: Validated computational pKa estimates, process evidence, sensitivity and conclusion.
